Two Latvians Arrested at UK Military Airbase

Two Latvian nationals were arrested after trespassing onto a military airbase in England. Counterterrorism police are investigating the incident, which occurred at a base used by the United States. The specific details of the breach and the individuals' motives remain under investigation.
